title: Cerebus Mothers & Daughters 1 - Oct #151 ~ 1991 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics
descriptionText:
Explore the intricate world of "Cerebus the Aardvark" with issue number 151, aptly titled "Mothers & Daughters." Published in October 1991, this comic book is a treasure for enthusiasts and collectors alike. Known for his groundbreaking work, Dave Sim's storytelling and artwork are showcased in this emblematic piece from the Copper Age of comics.

Delve into a narrative that weaves character development and complex storytelling, characteristic of Sim's acclaimed series. As a foundational part of the Aardvark-Vanaheim publisher's portfolio, this comic book is a must-have for those who appreciate the deep tradition of US Comics. Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the genre, this issue promises a compelling read.
